title: Figure 14. Schematic of Ultra-Sensitive HFGW Detector; Figure 15. Fractal Membrane photo
description: Figure 14 is a color 3D schematic of a cylindrical "Stainless Steel & Titanium Vacuum / Cryogenic Containment Vessel and Faraday Cage" containing Gaussian beam (GB) horns along Z, a "Fractal Membrane", "9T, 61mm gap Superconductor magnet" (N/S), and "Microwave Receiver (Detector 1)" and "(Detector 2)", with a "10 GHz, 10W microwave transmitter focused at fractal membrane" and a 2-meter scale. Below, Figure 15, "Fractal Membrane Component of Li-Baker Detector Exhibited in Planar Form", is a color photograph of a hand-held patterned membrane sheet.
